name: Gen1 Upgrade Review
description: GET-only bounded assessment and review of an explicitly selected Gen1 batch; no irreversible upgrade, consumer rewrite, refresh or permission changes.

variables.WORKSPACE_ID: Workspace containing the selected Gen1 items; the service assesses all Gen1 in this workspace.
variables.GEN1_ID: Explicit Gen1 dataflow UUID, never inferred from a name or an unrelated item.

steps.description: Validate explicit scope and preview read limits offline, without network or mutation.
Read bounded workspace assessments, emitting only selected evidence. Inspect unknown/partial scope, every reason and ALL reviewPlan blockers, not only status.

Review consumer/connector, cached-history reload/backup, BYOL/incremental-refresh, naming, schedules, permissions and post-upgrade validation risks. The planner does not inventory or repair consumers.

guarded_preview.description: Separate PREVIEW only, not execute. Keep both guards. Complete assessment is not approval or a receipt-safe submission workflow; the future execution phase must preserve uncertain/accepted work without blind resubmission.

stop_condition: No upgrade executes in this workflow. Explicit human approval and a guarded execution/correlated receipt phase are still required; do not silently switch to Save As, rewrite consumers, take over, grant access or refresh.
